verbatim: Pasqal's roadmap points to 10,000 qubits in 2026 with scalable logical qubits architecture.
headline: Pasqal's roadmap pointed to 10,000 qubits in 2026.
resolution_criteria: Scored as made on 12 March 2024. A later roadmap from the claimant that moves the date does not void the claim; it is logged as a check-in. Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2026 (plus grace), Pasqal operates or delivers a neutral-atom system with at least 10,000 physical qubits usable for computation. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if at least 10,000 atoms are trapped and controlled in a demonstration but not in an operated or delivered system. NOT_VERIFIED otherwise.
